propositions: Gate runs do not warn when the running build's commit is a strict ancestor of the pinned base ref, allowing reviews to proceed with stale code
Unknown config keys are reported with misleading 'typo?' guidance when the build is known to be behind the pinned ref, misdirecting operators
The running build's drift status must be detectable via resolve_gate_handle and reported as a one-time advisory warning per (build sha, pinned sha) pair without failing the run or altering verdicts
When build provenance is unavailable or drift cannot be established (different repos, build at or ahead, git unavailable), the gate must remain silent
Config unknown-key messages should distinguish between drifted and undrifted states to guide operators correctly
